US-Based Innodata Lays Off Nearly 550 Employees In India: Report. 👇 AI services company Innodata has reportedly cut nearly 550 jobs in India, accounting for around 5% of its global workforce. Affected employees reportedly lost access to company systems before receiving termination emails. Innodata has also reportedly laid off an undisclosed number of employees in the Philippines. The layoffs come amid broader workforce adjustments across the tech sector as companies reassess staffing and operations. 🔗 Read more about Innodata’s layoffs and the latest tech job cuts here: https://4-2.co/48mb6rB #Innodata #TechLayoffs #AIEconomy #WorkforceCuts #News
